parameters.content:
## 1. Trigger & Load Existing Leads
Runs 5x/day or manually. Pulls every lead already in Notion so
today's search never rediscovers the same site twice.

## 2. Build Today's Search Plan
Picks today's target niche + region (rotates daily) and builds
the strict system prompt the AI agent has to follow.

## 3. AI Discovery Agent
The only step with AI reasoning. Gemini + Perplexity + Google
Search propose candidate sites — nothing here is trusted yet.

## 4. Parse, Validate & Save
Extracts the JSON array, filters out anything already known,
and writes each new lead into Notion (or posts a no-leads alert).

## 5. Report to Slack
Posts the run summary to Slack once every new lead is saved.
